scope: read-only prospective CMP setup; no D3 decision or production consumer
formula: Unique explicitly linked descendant cycles; first valid published primary machine receipt by createdAt then producerRunId. Existing producer schema and receiptSha256 required; PASSED=1, business FAILED=0; root excluded; no smoothing. Unavailable-shell precondition is missing evidence: stop rather than count zero or skip to a later outcome. Exit codes alone do not identify infrastructure failure.
lineage: Explicit descriptor schemaVersion=1, identity=[project,ledger,unitId,activationEventId], parents=[identity,...]. Descriptor path named by snapshot.units[].lineagePath and bound in the FIRST primary receipt reviewedTree Git blob or actual file/directory declaredInputs manifest (producer input_snapshot algorithm). No inferred ancestry.

freeze.labelSeal: complete owner ratings integer0..4, first20 identities, campaignSha256, full snapshotSha256 and sealedAt; exclusive fixed-path publication after maturity and before numeric disclosure
freeze.integrityBoundary: honest host/operator integrity; seals are checksums, not owner authentication or cryptographic blinding

cohort.roots: first20 verified no-parent cycles activated after freeze and closed strictly after freeze/before end; chosen before outcome or exposure
cohort.ties: close time then full identity; future Spearman uses average tied ranks
cohort.censoring: descendants without terminal closure inside window reported separately, never success/failure
cohort.missingEvidence: visible fail-closed error, never imputed or omitted
cohort.randomization: N/A observational association, no treatment; blind worksheet order shuffled using preregistered seed
cohort.carryover: one root per lineage and pairwise disjoint descendant sets
cohort.sealedSplit: formula frozen before all prospective observations; entire prospective cohort held out

anchors: sustained broad reuse without unresolved severe regression
allowlist: source evidence references excluding first-machine outcomes

futureDecisionOnly.power: Fisher-z Gaussian approximation, N=20 rho=.6 alpha=.01; not an exact Spearman guarantee
futureDecisionOnly.attempts: One decision attempt per frozen formula; future decision unit persists intent before numeric reveal; never retune against labels or retry the same formula/window
futureDecisionOnly.retry: new preregistration and new prospective window, no historical reuse
futureDecisionOnly.negativeControl: report mean Spearman rho across the same 9999 shuffled pairings; expected zero, not substitute for observed effect
futureDecisionOnly.consumerGate: No operational ranking, reward, model routing or self-modification before separately accepted D3 decision
futureDecisionOnly.decisionImplementation: Deferred; must consume this unchanged instrument/protocol and add a separate runner, not edit frozen formula

baseline.manualRankingBaselineReason: No comparable formal ranking workflow existed before setup
baseline.paybackStatus: unmeasured hypothesis; measure comparable owner ranking effort at future decision
baseline.setupCI: N/A deterministic software acceptance; future statistical methods specified separately
baseline.rollback: archive campaign and stop using instrument; no lifecycle, production policy, model choice or rewards changed

privacy.handling: Do not copy raw prompts/provider output/secrets into CMP source bundles. Apply source-side scrubbing before original receipts are sealed; never alter sealed evidence to hide omissions. Existing owner retention policy governs local raw material.

interpretation: Unvalidated empirical ITD proxy inspired by descendant outcomes; not causal unlocking, HGM theorem reproduction, or demonstrated effectiveness.
